description:
Grant-wired buyer order read (safe scope buyer_orders_read_minimal; OAuth grant). Reads YOUR OWN orders — minimal projection only (order_id/status/next_actor/deadline/amount/item_ref/payment_rail), NO address/recipient/contact/notes, no execution.
- order_id → that order (+ tracking no. once shipped); omitted → your buyer order list (most recent first). payment_rail = funds semantics; amounts are read-only.
- changed_since=ISO time → only orders changed since (shipped/delivered/returns/disputes); reply has as_of for next check.
- Seller-side orders not here (use webaz_get_agent_order). No grant → GRANT_REQUIRED; missing scope → PERMISSION_REQUIRED (re-connect).
- Cancel/return: webaz_buyer_action_request (owner approves); disputes & receipt: owner on webaz.xyz.

changed_since.description: Without order_id: orders changed since this ISO time.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous next_cursor (older orders).

full.description: With order_id: return the FULL view (timeline/terms/logistics/deadlines/refunds/available_actions; needs buyer_orders_read)

limit.description: List page size, default 10 (max 50). The list returns a whole-account summary + active orders first.

order_id.description: Order ID. Omit to list your buyer orders (minimal projection).

updated_since.description: With full: incremental read — unchanged order returns a tiny up_to_date response; otherwise timeline contains only entries newer than this ISO timestamp.

name: webaz_buyer_orders

outputSchema.description: webaz.order_status.model.v1 (list/minimal/up_to_date) OR webaz.order_timeline.model.v2 (full single-order timeline: status labels, USDC price + display-only fiat estimate, rail-honest refund state, server-authoritative actions) — zero PII

error.description: present ONLY on failure (with error_code + structured recovery fields)

next_cursor.description: older orders exist — pass back as cursor

order_outcome.description: full form: fulfilled and platform_settled as two separate facts; money_moved_by_webaz

payment.description: full form: method, executor, order_url, payable {currency,amount,source}, estimate? (never the amount due), payment_verified, verification_source

quantity.description: positive integer, or null when invalid (see quantity_valid); display-only (amount=price.amount_minor)

quantity_valid.description: false only when quantity is invalid data (card shows 数量数据异常, buttons disabled)

refund.description: rail-honest refund state: records[] {kind,responsible_party,executed,evidence}; ABSENT when there is no refund record

status.description: timeline (v2) form: {code, label, label_en} object; up_to_date (order_status v1) form: raw status code string

timeline.description: full form: {seq,from,to_status,actor,at,by?} events in true step order (seq); status labels follow the payment method

type.description: BUG-06 v2 discriminator on the full timeline form: "order_timeline" (absent on the minimal order_status list)
